name: Hello Betty
description: A tiny sample pack. Betty answers when you say hello.

jokes.setup: Why did the cube say hello twice?
jokes.punchline: Six faces. Somebody has to greet everyone.

jokes.setup: Why does Betty love rainy days?
jokes.punchline: Finally, a reason to stay inside the box.

morning: Hello, early bird. The box is warm.
Morning! Say hello and I will wave.
